description: This file declares the RenderFrame class, which is a task related to rendering a frame in a media player context. It includes references to context and wrapper classes for GStreamer and Glib, indicating its role in media rendering within the Rialto server component.

classes.name: RenderFrame
classes.description: A class representing a task to render a frame, implementing the IPlayerTask interface. It holds references to the player context and wrapper objects for GStreamer and Glib, and provides an execute method to perform the rendering.

methods.name: RenderFrame
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the RenderFrame task with the given context and wrapper objects.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the rendering of a frame when called.
